data.body:
Impact: the replaced `Status` line drops the trailing two-space Markdown hard line-break that the original line had (and that every other ADR in this repo uses, e.g. `docs/adr/001-threaded-handler-execution.md`'s `**Status:** Accepted  ` / `**Date:** ...`). Without a hard break or a blank line separator, GitHub's Markdown renderer will collapse the newline into a single space, so "Status: Superseded by ADR-006" and "Date: 2026-07-02" will render run-together on one paragraph line instead of as two lines, breaking the header layout used consistently elsewhere in `docs/adr/`.

Fix: restore the trailing two-space hard break on this line (or add a blank line before the `Date` line, matching the paragraph-separated style already used for the new ADR-006 header).
